advancements.arcamod.boss_slayer.descrip: Kill the Wither, an Elder Guardian, a Warden and the Ender Dragon yourself. Unlocks the elytra slot.
advancements.arcamod.boss_slayer.title: Slayer of Giants
advancements.arcamod.first_iron.descript: Mine iron ore. Only copper tools bite deep enough.
advancements.arcamod.first_iron.title: First Iron
advancements.arcamod.flint_dagger.descri: One flint, one stick: your first blade.
advancements.arcamod.flint_dagger.title: Knapped Blade
advancements.arcamod.flint_tool.descript: Two flints, cord and two sticks: at last, something that cuts wood, stone and copper.
advancements.arcamod.flint_tool.title: Flint Tool
advancements.arcamod.pebble.description: Gather a pebble from the ground, on the surface or in caves. Bare hands no longer get anything out of wood.
advancements.arcamod.pebble.title: Pick Up a Pebble
advancements.arcamod.plant_fiber.descrip: Cut grass with the flint dagger to gather fibres, then twist them into cord.
advancements.arcamod.plant_fiber.title: Plant Fibres
advancements.arcamod.stick.description: Pick up a stick from the ground, or break leaves bare-handed: they sometimes drop one.
advancements.arcamod.stick.title: Find a Stick
arcamod.config.title: ArcaMod: features
arcamod.feature.allay_bucket.tooltip: Catch an allay with an empty bucket, with whatever it is holding.
arcamod.feature.apply.restart: Takes effect the next time the game starts.
arcamod.feature.apply.world_reload: Takes effect the next time the world is loaded.
arcamod.feature.arrow_new_parts.tooltip: The fletching table accepts chorus, netherite, echo, sulfur, dripstone, gold, copper, pink gold, quartz, sugar cane, end rod, turtle scute, kelp and bat wing.
arcamod.feature.arrow_part_effects.toolt: Damage, explosion, fire, no gravity... for fletching table arrows.
arcamod.feature.ash_fertilizer.tooltip: Ash works like weak bone meal: often it does nothing.
arcamod.feature.ash_lye.tooltip: Ash turns cauldron water into lye, washing three times more items per level.
arcamod.feature.bat_wing_drops.tooltip: Bats killed by a player drop wings.
arcamod.feature.beacon_netherite_range.t: A netherite block under a beacon greatly extends its range.
arcamod.feature.bed_needs_shelter.toolti: You cannot sleep under the open sky.
arcamod.feature.bookshelf_range.tooltip: Bookshelves count up to 10 blocks from the enchanting table; the further away they are, the more of them are needed (60 at 10 blocks for level 30).
arcamod.feature.broken_tools_kept.toolti: At zero durability the tool stays in your inventory, unusable until repaired.
arcamod.feature.brush_feather_repair.too: The brush can be repaired in an anvil with a feather.
arcamod.feature.bundle_interface.tooltip: Sneak + right-click a bundle to open its contents as an inventory.
arcamod.feature.burnt_logs.tooltip: Burning trees can leave burnt logs at their base, crafted into charcoal.
arcamod.feature.camp_banner.tooltip: A banner near a lit campfire stops monsters spawning around it.
arcamod.feature.campfire_resting.tooltip: Sitting on a cushion near a lit campfire restores health and hunger.
arcamod.feature.cauldron_arrow_dipping.t: Right-click a potion cauldron with arrows: tipped arrows.
arcamod.feature.cauldron_washing.tooltip: A water cauldron removes dye from wool, carpets, beds, glass, terracotta...
arcamod.feature.chiseled_bookshelf_names: Looking at a book in a chiseled bookshelf shows its name or enchantments above the hotbar. Needs the mod on the server.
arcamod.feature.copper_oxidation.tooltip: Copper tools and armor oxidize over time (faster in rain) and wear out faster the more they oxidize.
arcamod.feature.copper_storm.tooltip: During thunderstorms, copper armor attracts lightning. Struck in full copper armor: Haste and Speed II for 8 minutes.
arcamod.feature.copper_waxing.tooltip: Combine copper gear with a honeycomb to freeze its oxidation. An axe in the crafting grid removes the wax without being used up.
arcamod.feature.dagger_throwing.tooltip: Right-click to throw the flint dagger.
arcamod.feature.drowned_trident_drops.to: Adjustable chance for drowned to drop their trident.
arcamod.feature.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Held torches, dropped glowing items, flaming arrows, burning mobs, fireballs... light up their surroundings.
arcamod.feature.echo_trims.tooltip: Combine trimmed armor with an echo shard: its trim slowly pulses with light.
arcamod.feature.egg_placing.tooltip: Sneak + right-click with an egg places it (hatches on a hay bale).
arcamod.feature.elytra_dyeing.tooltip: Elytra + dye in a crafting table, like leather. A water cauldron washes the dye off.
arcamod.feature.elytra_harness.tooltip: Craft a netherite chestplate with intact elytra, a nether star and 4 phantom membranes: it can glide, but flying wears it out fast.
arcamod.feature.elytra_slot.tooltip: After killing the four bosses, a + button next to the chestplate opens a slot for a pair of elytra, independent of the chestplate.
arcamod.feature.elytra_trims.tooltip: Every armor trim can be applied to vanilla elytra at the smithing table (not patchwork elytra).
arcamod.feature.enchanting_crystal.toolt: Charged by nearby deaths, rerolls enchanting offers.
arcamod.feature.enderman_head_detector.t: An Enderman head emits redstone when a player looks at it, stronger when closer.
arcamod.feature.enderman_head_drops.tool: An Enderman killed by a charged creeper explosion drops its head.
arcamod.feature.faster_leaf_decay.toolti: Leaves of a cut tree disappear faster (x4 by default).
arcamod.feature.feather_falling_no_tramp: Boots with Feather Falling no longer trample farmland.
arcamod.feature.feather_push.tooltip: Hitting a creature with a feather pushes it without hurting or angering it.
arcamod.feature.fire_charge_throwing.too: Right-click a fire charge to throw a ghast fireball.
arcamod.feature.fire_resistance_lava_vis: Fire Resistance lets you see much further under lava (ArcaBalance.FIRE_RESISTANCE_LAVA_FOG_END).
arcamod.feature.fire_tweaks.tooltip: Fire spreads more (x2) and blocks burn longer (x2).
arcamod.feature.fishing_rod_stand.toolti: A stand that fishes on its own: place a rod, wait 1 to 2 minutes, then pull it back by hand or with a redstone pulse for an 85% chance at the vanilla fishing loot.
arcamod.feature.fletching_table.tooltip: Right-click the fletching table: craft arrows from tip + shaft + fletching.
arcamod.feature.flint_hint.tooltip: After 5 minutes of play without flint, a message tells where to find some (only once).
arcamod.feature.gear_smelting_nuggets.to: Smelting gear gives more nuggets (ArcaBalance, section 9).
arcamod.feature.gear_stacking.tooltip: Undamaged tools, armor and potions stack (size: ArcaBalance.GEAR_STACK_SIZE).
arcamod.feature.glowing_trims.tooltip: Trimmed armor + glow ink sac: the trim glows.
arcamod.feature.goat_extra_drops.tooltip: A slain goat drops wool 65% of the time, and a random goat horn 5% of the time.
arcamod.feature.item_frame_hiding.toolti: Phantom membrane on a filled frame makes it invisible: clicks pass through it, and bone meal brings it back.
arcamod.feature.item_frame_snapping.tool: Frames stick to the block's real shape (fences, walls, panes, posts) instead of floating, and can be hung on small-model blocks.
arcamod.feature.leaves_hand_sticks.toolt: Breaking leaves bare-handed sometimes drops a stick (20% by default).
arcamod.feature.logs_require_tool.toolti: Logs drop nothing when broken by hand (tag arcamod:requires_tool_for_drops).
arcamod.feature.moss_slab_spreading.tool: Moss slabs and stairs spread moss with bone meal, like the full block.
arcamod.feature.nautilus_shell_drops.too: Nautiluses drop their shell more often.
Shipwreck treasure chests can contain the Pink Gold Upgrade smithing template.
arcamod.feature.plant_fiber_from_grass.t: Cutting grass with a dagger or a sword gives plant fibers. Blade + grass in a crafting table: one fiber per grass.
arcamod.feature.potion_cauldron.tooltip: Pour potions into a cauldron and bathe creatures in them.
arcamod.feature.quiver.tooltip: Arrow storage, shooting from the quiver and left-click arrow switching.
arcamod.feature.resin_sticking.tooltip: Resin shots and resin-tipped arrows freeze movement and view. Jump several times to break free.
arcamod.feature.rope.tooltip: Rope and rope plates: anchored under a block, unrolled to the ground, cut by shears or arrows, and breaking under the weight of unsecured climbers.
arcamod.feature.scarecrow.tooltip: A dummy that shows the damage of every hit, in hearts. Sneak and punch it bare-handed to break it. Resin freezes what it holds, an axe scrapes it off.
arcamod.feature.sign_hiding.tooltip: Phantom membrane on a written sign hides the board, leaving only the text. Bone meal brings it back.
arcamod.feature.sign_snapping.tooltip: Wall signs stick to the block's real shape (fences, walls, panes) instead of floating.
arcamod.feature.slingshot.tooltip: Draw and shoot pebbles, amethyst shards, iron nuggets or resin clumps.
arcamod.feature.smoke_bomb.tooltip: Ash and sulfur: a thrown smoke cloud that makes mobs lose track of you.
Any suspicious sand or gravel may hold a sniffer egg.
arcamod.feature.sniffer_xp_berries.toolt: Sniffers can dig up XP berries.
arcamod.feature.soul_pepper.tooltip: Soul peppers grow in soul sand valleys. Eating one sets your melee hits on fire for a minute.
arcamod.feature.starter_chest_progressio: The spawn bonus chest gives sticks, pebbles, fibers and food instead of wooden tools and logs.
arcamod.feature.stick_placing.tooltip: Sneak + right-click with a stick places it on the ground.
arcamod.feature.sulfur_brushing.tooltip: Brushing a sulfur block yields 0 to 3 sulfur powder, then it is exhausted.
arcamod.feature.sulfur_cube_drops.toolti: Sulfur cubes killed by a player drop 0 to 2 sulfur powder.
arcamod.feature.thatch.tooltip: Axe on hay bales, thatch aging, resin waxing and scraping.
arcamod.feature.tipped_arrow_clouds.tool: Tipped arrows leave a lingering cloud where they land.
arcamod.feature.tnt_barrel.tooltip: Twice as strong as TNT, drops nothing and turns nearby lava into basalt or crying obsidian. Stays a block once lit.
arcamod.feature.tool_belt.tooltip: A belt worn above the shield slot: swap tools with a key, lanterns inside keep glowing.
arcamod.feature.tool_trims.tooltip: Armor trims also apply to swords, pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes and bows.
arcamod.feature.trident_damage_buff.tool: The trident hits 30% harder, both in hand and thrown (ArcaBalance.TRIDENT_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER).
arcamod.feature.trident_prismarine_repai: The trident can be repaired at the anvil with prismarine shards (ArcaBalance.TRIDENT_REPAIR_ITEM).
arcamod.feature.turtle_brushing.tooltip: Brushing an adult turtle can yield a turtle scute.
arcamod.feature.turtle_helmet_underwater: Wearing a turtle helmet removes the underwater mining speed penalty, like Aqua Affinity.
arcamod.feature.village_chest_pebbles.to: Adds pebbles to village house chests.
arcamod.feature.weathering_bricks.toolti: Bricks (vanilla ones included: blocks, stairs, slabs, walls) age like copper: new, faded, worn, weathered, cracked. Resin turns them into waxed bricks (vanilla look) that never age; an axe turns those back to vanilla.
arcamod.feature.wooden_tool_nerf.tooltip: Reduced durability and mining speed (ArcaBalance, section 2).
arcamod.feature.worldgen_cave_pebbles.to: Pebble piles appear on cave floors (new chunks).
arcamod.feature.worldgen_pebbles.tooltip: Generates pebbles on the ground (new chunks).
arcamod.feature.worldgen_pink_gold_ore.t: Pink gold ore forms where gold and copper ore veins touch.
arcamod.feature.worldgen_sticks.tooltip: Generates fallen sticks on the ground (new chunks).
arcamod.feature.xp_berry_brewing.tooltip: XP berry + water bottles = bottles o' enchanting.
arcamod.feature.xp_berry_eating.tooltip: Right-click an XP berry to gain experience.
arcamod.feature.xp_bottler.tooltip: The machine drains player experience into bottles.
arrow_part.arcamod.fletching.armadillo_s: faster, quicker bow draw, less accurate
arrow_part.arcamod.fletching.bat_wing.de: bonus damage at night and in the dark
arrow_part.arcamod.fletching.kelp.desc: a target hit in water sinks and can't swim up
arrow_part.arcamod.fletching.phantom_mem: longer range, bonus damage against flying creatures
arrow_part.arcamod.fletching.turtle_scut: flies true underwater, shorter range in air
arrow_part.arcamod.shaft.blaze_rod.desc: sets targets on fire, fizzles in water
arrow_part.arcamod.shaft.bone.desc: very heavy, passes through leaves, breaks glass
arrow_part.arcamod.shaft.breeze_rod.desc: no gravity for 3 s, almost no knockback
arrow_part.arcamod.shaft.end_rod.desc: glows in flight and once stuck
arrow_part.arcamod.shaft.sugar_cane.desc: light: quicker bow draw, less damage and knockback
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.chorus.desc: teleports the target randomly, hits endermen, almost no damage
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.copper.desc: more damage to wet targets, calls lightning in storms
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.echo.desc: silent decoy for the Warden and sculk, triple damage against the Warden
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.gold.desc: chance of double loot, only the piglin hit gets angry, reduced damage
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.netherite.desc: very strong, disables shields, never lost, heavy
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.pink_gold.desc: fast, stronger from an enchanted bow
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.prismarine.desc: double damage against aquatic or wet creatures
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.quartz.desc: always critical, weak against armor, shatters on impact
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.resin.desc: 1 damage, sticks the target in place
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.sulfur.desc: nausea and poison, wears armor, reduced damage
arrow_part.arcamod.tip.wind_charge.desc: bursts like a wind charge, gives air, 2x faster bow draw
item.arcamod.arrow_parts.name: %s (%s)
item.arcamod.smithing_template.pink_gold: Add copper or gold armor, weapon, or tool
key.arcamod.tool_belt: Tool belt (tap: swap, hold + scroll: select, release: take)
message.arcamod.bed_needs_shelter: You cannot sleep outdoors: this bed needs a roof over it.
message.arcamod.crystal_not_charged: This crystal is empty: a creature must die near it.
message.arcamod.crystal_reroll: The crystal shatters: the enchanting table has new offers.
message.arcamod.logs_require_tool: Bare hands are not enough for wood. Gather a pebble and a stick from the ground (or break leaves bare-handed), then knap a flint dagger.
message.arcamod.no_flint_yet: Still no flint? Break the small pebble piles (on the surface or in caves), or dig gravel by hand: both sometimes drop some.
message.arcamod.resin_free: You broke free from the resin
message.arcamod.resin_jumps_left: Stuck in resin! Jump to break free (%s left)
message.arcamod.tool_belt.no_room: No room to put away the held item
